title: Veil and Choir
author: Cyrus Amberdale
blurb: Paloma Brightwater, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
